text:
incident-bot: 🔔 [ALERT] High 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate in eu-west-1 (P1) — 12m ago. Error rate: 18% -> 5xx spike. Alert: https://alerts.redwood.local/alerts/38721

alice_oncall: on it, pinging release team. noticing errors align with a recent hotpatch deploy?

dave_release: yes, we pushed hotpatch r-2026.3 to eu-west-1 ~14m ago to address kernel quant path. Canary was 10% with `feature: prefetch-cache` enabled. rolling to 100% was scheduled but should not be active yet.

bob_sre: grabbing logs now. seeing OOM traces from the sticky-cache worker and connection resets. sample log: ```2026-03-17T21:12:34Z ERROR sticky_cache: allocate failed: OOM at 0x7f... stack: kv_prefetch() -> cache_write()```

alice_oncall: can we flip the feature flag to kill the prefetch-cache for eu-west-1 only? that should stop the leak while we investigate.

dave_release: agreed. command to toggle: `redwoodctl feature toggle prefetch-cache --env=prod --region=eu-west-1 --off` — I can run but will coordinate with oncall.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: Received request to toggle feature `prefetch-cache` by dave_release at 2026-03-17T21:18:02Z. Starting safe toggle (gradual 50% -> 0%).

bob_sre: note: there are still active connections holding large KV caches. we should drain sticky-cache workers after flag flip. Suggest: 1) disable flag 2) scale down sticky-cache to 0, wait 60s, scale up 3) monitor 5xx.

alice_oncall: dave, please execute toggle, i'll run the drain steps.

dave_release: running toggle now.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: Feature `prefetch-cache` toggled OFF in eu-west-1 by dave_release at 2026-03-17T21:20:11Z. Progress: 100%.

bob_sre: initiating drain: `kubectl scale deployment/sticky-cache -n inference --replicas=0 --context=eu-west-1`

carol_pg: support note — we're seeing ~120 active incidents in the queue with customers reporting degraded responses for embedding-heavy endpoints. tagging CS for updates.

alice_oncall: 1) 5xx rate dropping from 18% -> 4% in the last 3m. 2) latency still elevated for some requests. monitoring logs for residual OOMs.

eve_support: opening incident summary for CS: "Hotpatch caused sticky-cache OOM in eu-west-1; feature `prefetch-cache` disabled; drain initiated; customers affected: embedding-heavy tenants, small uplift in error rates resolved for most after drain." linking to status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-17-38721

bob_sre: rescaling back up: `kubectl scale deployment/sticky-cache -n inference --replicas=3 --context=eu-west-1` — healthchecks passing. no new OOM traces in logs for last 8m.

dave_release: investigating root cause in CI: suspicious memory accounting change in the quant-kernel path; will open a PR to revert the change that was included in r-2026.3.

alice_oncall: preparing a short postmortem note for handoff. current status: 5xx baseline restored to 0.9% (pre-deploy baseline was 0.8%). No rollback required; kill-switch + drain mitigated. Will escalate to eng-runtime for follow-up.

frank_oncall: picking up handoff for night shift. summary: incident P1 -> caused by hotpatch r-2026.3 enabling prefetch-cache; mitigation: toggled feature off for eu-west-1 and drained sticky-cache workers; system stable. next actions for oncall: watch for recurrence, validate PR revert candidate from dave, confirm canary gating in rollout pipeline.

alice_oncall: handing off to frank_oncall. all alerts silenced, monitoring at Green. I added notes to the incident ticket: https://tickets.redwood.local/INC-38721. If anything spikes, page frank (oncall) and ping the release team.

frank_oncall: acknowledged. I'll keep watchers and check 1h/2h snapshots. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-38721 marked RESOLVED by alice_oncall at 2026-03-17T22:14:00Z. Resolution: feature toggle + worker drain. Follow-up: eng-runtime assigned for root-cause fix and safer canary gating.
